# uzc_virtual_router (Resource)

Manages a UzCloud virtual router. There is no update endpoint (only reboot), so changing any attribute recreates the resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uzc_virtual_router" "example" {
  name           = "example-vr"
  cloud_provider = "nimbo"
  networks       = [uzc_network.example.slug]
  plan           = "vr-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `plan` (String)

### Optional

- `billing_cycle` (String) Billing cycle slug. Falls back to the provider's `billing_cycle` default when unset.
- `cloud_provider` (String) Cloud provider slug. Falls back to the provider's `cloud_provider` default when unset.
- `description` (String)
- `enable_nat` (Boolean)
- `networks` (List of String) Network slugs attached to this virtual router.
- `project` (String) Project slug. Falls back to the provider's `project` default when unset.
- `region` (String) Region slug. Falls back to the provider's `region` default when unset.
- `storage_category` (String)
- `vr_plan` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same value as `slug`. Used as the Terraform resource ID.
- `slug` (String) Server-assigned slug, used for import.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uzc_virtual_router.example <virtual-router-slug>
```
